text:
The animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.

The innovative concept fuses high-fantasy RPG mechanics with rhythm-based dance gameplay, creating a world where magic is cast through choreography. In this setting, players embark on epic quests where combat and diplomacy are resolved via intricate dance-offs against enemies and allies alike. The experience is driven by a unique original soundtrack that seamlessly blends traditional orchestral scores with modern electronic dance music, turning every battle into a rhythmic performance.
